title: 2026년 11월 6일, 인공지능 분야에서 무슨 일이 일어났을까요?
intro: Agents are getting real privileges, and the work today is controlling them: Stripe agents can now move money, Zalando published an OAuth broker for scoped access, and one developer's agent escalated to root through the docker group.
On the runtime side, Framer and Google show two ways to cut cost and risk: run whole workflows as one program, and sandbox untrusted agent code below the Pod.
highlights: Stripe's MCP server lets agents send money through Treasury.
Zalando's Agentic Identity Broker gives agents scoped, revocable MCP access.
Google donates Agent Substrate and gVisor to the CNCF for agent sandboxing.
Framer's Harness 2 reports up to 33% lower cost by running workflows as one program.
Open-weight models win at 3% of price points, down from 41% in June (Village).
